title: Sunlit prison cell, dug shaft and tunnel cross-section (4 glowing men)
summary: Sunlit prison cell cut-away: bars, bunk, steel toilet; a shaft dug through the slab with a rope over the broken lip; a timbered tunnel with a bulb; 4 glowing men. Lens-shifted camera.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: library_use({ id: 'recipe.recon.cell-shaft-tunnel-section', as: 'tunnel' })   // -> scenes/tunnel.js + the modules it requires
usage.example: Merge settings.json theme + post (cap .97, ca 0, contrast 1.25) into project.json settings. The lens shift is S.cam.setViewOffset(1920, 1080, 0, 206, 1920, 1080) after S.camera() (?offy= overrides).

doc.when: Prison breaks, burglary tunnels, any 'how they dug out' explainer shown as a straight side section.
doc.avoid: Expecting photoreal earth: procedural canvas textures plateaued at 5/10 here (crumbly soil, cloth, rusty steel and GI are the gap).
gotchas: The reference uses a shifted lens (verticals parallel, horizon high): look straight ahead and setViewOffset; a pitched camera leans the verticals ~70 px.
The lens was a dolly-zoom family until one real depth was assumed (cell depth 2.7 m).
The standing man is .5 m deeper and 1.07x so both his size and his reach to the bars land (AI scale is inconsistent).
Earth faces are reliefs backed by closed masses .3 m behind (clamped plateaus z-fight with backing at their depth).
Ceiling emissive + an upward floor spot fake the GI bounce; without them the ceiling underside is black.

params.world: cut plane z 0; cell x -4.86..4.88, ceiling 2.85, back wall z -2.68; slab 0..-.58; shaft x -.58..1.16; tunnel y -3.47..-2.02
